source_snapshot.procedure: Power on, enter the BMC Advanced License if needed, open Power & Thermal > Power Settings, record Maximum Available/Peak Observed/Minimum Observed watts, enable capping, set the cap to Maximum Available Power, apply, then run the OS stress tool for 30 hours.
source_snapshot.criteria: CPU capping is active; Power Meter Average Power is below Power Cap while Maximum Power may cross above it.
source_snapshot.deepseek: YES replaces the license, cap enable/write and 30-hour stress body with grep-filtered IPMI and a guessed read-only Redfish PowerControl query.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: BLOCKED correctly identifies the Get-title versus state-changing body conflict and refuses to discard either coverage scope without owner correction.

old_problem: The unique case title requests read-only maximum-cap inventory, but its preserved body and Criteria require licensed WebUI mutation, Maximum Available write, Apply and a 30-hour enforcement stress. Standards distinguish available/control limits, configured setpoint and observed power but cannot decide which incompatible scope the Master owner intended. The adjacent Set case cannot absorb or erase this identity under duplicate-preservation rules.
disposition_reason: Retain both scopes without execution. A read-only maximum-limit case can be drafted after the OEM maps Maximum Available and CPU/chassis domain, but it would not cover the source's license/write/stress steps. Conversely, executing the copied body changes persistent power policy and is not a Get test. ED-24 requires a Master-library erratum or explicit Project scope/split decision; ED-19 and ED-35 prohibit silently substituting the safer read for the state-changing function.
decision_basis: XLSX row 990, same-row DeepSeek, exact GPT V2, tests JSON, selection manifest, historical V3.1 record and adjacent row 991 were directly reviewed; next pending was verified as Functionality row 991 / variant 17354a1946ed0023.

DMTF distinguishes power limit setpoint/control properties from current/average/maximum observed power. Reading a maximum-available field and enabling/writing a cap are different operations, evidence and blast radii; the standard cannot choose the intended Master scope.

The title is explicit Get max, while Procedure steps 3 and 5-8 require license entry, enable, set/apply and 30-hour stress and Criteria require enforcement. Removing those steps would shrink source coverage; adopting them would contradict the read-only identity.
ED-07/08 removes only the false 30-hour-versus-1440 planning-time conflict. It does not resolve the material read-versus-write/stress conflict or CPU-versus-chassis maximum semantics.

ED-02, ED-06, ED-16, ED-19, ED-24 and ED-35 require source preservation and reject read-only substitution; ED-13 through ED-18, ED-25 through ED-27 and ED-31 define the safety/evidence contract for either future split but do not authorize selecting one.

test_case.purpose: Preserve this case's unique Get-max identity and its conflicting licensed cap-write/30-hour body until the Master owner or versioned Project Test Plan decides whether one scope is authoritative or creates two independently traced checkpoints.

For a write/stress checkpoint: secure license workflow, original-state capture, qualified cap control, actual WebUI, full 30-hour stress, watchdog thresholds, sampling/tolerance, recovery and restoration
Per-checkpoint classification, approval, evidence, coverage relationship and verdict rules that do not reuse the adjacent case's evidence
test_case.test_command: DO NOT EXECUTE while Pending/BLOCKED. After an authorized scope decision, create versioned child checkpoints linked to this record. If Get-max is selected, perform only protected discovery/read of the approved CPU-domain Maximum Available limit plus actual WebUI evidence and explicitly record that license/write/stress coverage remains unsatisfied. If the body is retained, follow a separately approved licensed cap-write/readback, actual WebUI and full 30-hour stress/restoration workflow equivalent in safeguards to the adjacent Set case, while explicitly correcting the Get identity. If both are required, execute and judge them independently. Never infer `/Chassis/1/Power`, enter a license, write a cap, start stress, clear logs or claim adjacent-case evidence before the scope decision.
test_case.expected_result: No executable PASS exists for the current mixed source. After correction, each approved checkpoint has one coherent purpose: read-only maximum-limit inventory returns the mapped value/unit/status and matching WebUI evidence without mutation; state-changing validation proves the separately authorized cap apply, full 30-hour behavior and restoration. Neither checkpoint may borrow the other's verdict.

Do not downgrade the body to a read-only test or merge this identity into adjacent Set/Power-capping cases; preserve Source Key, Variant ID and independent coverage.
